html:
For a limited time, leading up to final contract signing, after which the manuscript goes to my publisher, I am enlisting the help of fans of my blog in providing early reader feedback on Wormhole.  If you would like to participate in my early reader feedback program I can send a pre-edited draft version of Wormhole to your kindle or a pdf formatted version to your other ebook reader.  In return, I just ask that you not share it with others and that you give me your general impressions of the novel (my editor will take care of the actual edit).  If you have a real kindle device, I can send it directly to that.  It won’t
work with the kindle app though.

1.  Go to the Manage Your Kindle page on Amazon.com
a. Click on the link on the left hand side that says Personal Document Settings
b. Add my email account to the Approved Personal Document E-mail List(richard.phillips@secondship.net)

2.  Click on the Manage Your Devices link on the left
a. Send me the Kindle E-mail Address for your kindle (something@kindle.com).
It will end in @kindle.com

Let me know if you’re interested via my email at Richard.Phillips@secondship.net

Best,

Richard

comments.html:
I hope the book will be translated into Portuguese and is released in Brazil. I commented on the stories to many friends but they are waiting to be launched here to read. Congratulations, long time since I had read anything as good science fiction involving extraterrestrials somehow.

Already sent you and e-mail to be part of the early reader feedback. Thank you very much!

comments.author: Goolic (@Goolic)
comments.html: I kinda wat to be in the early feedback, but i think i prefer to keep the final version unspoiled !

comments.author: Ron Malcolm
comments.html:
Richard

Wormhole, another home run. I have been reading science fiction for roughly 55 years. The books in the Rho Agenda are as good or better than those written by many of my favorite authors, Asimov, Clarke, Niven, Weber and several outside the genre such as Dan Brown, Dean Koontz, Michael Cricthton and Steven King all who have at times written science fiction. Wormhole is a great read. I hope someone decides to do movies of these books as I think they will be great.

Thank you.

comments.author: Ben
comments.html: I’ve been waiting to read it for a long time but the only kindle I have is the iPhone app. I’m tempted to just go and buy a kindle but I think I’ll wait until it’s released. If it doesn’t come to New Zealand due to geographic restrictions I’ll be quite displeased. It’s the first science fiction series I’m read in years that has somehow managed to seamlessly blend so many sci-fi and action elements. I read the first two in a couple of days and now I’m craving more.
